# czc-v2026.10.22.4 (0.2.17.21)

Requests that carry screenshots or other inline images no longer fail with a
false "context window exceeded" error while the real context is far below the
model limit.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.22.3

### Codex full synthesis

- **Images are charged by pixel area in the context budget.** The synthesis
  budget check (`codexSynthesisEstimatedTokens`) estimated tokens as JSON
  bytes / 4, which counted base64 image data as text. A ~600 KB base64
  screenshot was estimated at ~150k tokens while the model bills about 900,
  so conversations with a few screenshots were rejected with
  `codex synthesis: request exceeds the model context window`
  (67 occurrences on `/responses` since 0.2.17.19 was deployed).
- Inline images (`data:image/...` URLs such as `input_image.image_url`, and
  base64 `data` next to an image `media_type` / `mime_type`) are now charged
  `w*h/750` tokens after the upstream resize bounds, decoded from the image
  header only. Undecodable images (for example WebP) are charged a flat 1600.
  All other content keeps the 4 bytes/token heuristic.

### Related fix outside this repository (already deployed)

- The CLIProxyAPI Devin executor behind the `Devin2Claude` account had the same
  len/4 estimate in its context guard and `count_tokens`. It rejected
  `claude-opus-5-5` / `swe-2` conversations with
  `estimated prompt tokens (N) exceed maximum context length (N)` while real
  usage was 57k–300k tokens. Fixed in CLIProxyAPI `dev` (211077fb) and
  redeployed; a real 4-image Claude Code payload is now counted at 180,589
  tokens instead of about 620,000.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.21`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration and no configuration change.

## Compatibility

- Text-only requests get the same estimate as before (+/-1 token rounding).
- Only the gateway-side budget estimate changes; the upstream still enforces
  its own real context limit.

## Verification

Passed:

- `gofmt -l` on the changed Go files: clean.
- `go vet ./internal/service/`, `go build ./...`.
- `go test -count=1 ./...` — 52/52 packages with tests pass, 0 failed.
- New tests in `image_token_estimate_test.go`: pixel-area estimate for a
  700x900 PNG (1 MB+ base64 → 840 tokens), data URL form, WebP fallback,
  resize bounds, Responses `input_image` and Claude `image` items in
  `codexSynthesisEstimatedTokens`, budget no longer rejects screenshots,
  text-only estimate unchanged.
- Existing `codexSynthesisTrimToBudget` tests still pass.
- CLIProxyAPI side: deployed binary returns `count_tokens` 180,589 for a
  real 4-image Claude Code payload (old formula: about 620,000).

Failed or skipped:

- The `-tags unit` service suite was not re-run for this release; the 12
  pre-existing failures listed in the czc-v2026.10.22.2 notes are unrelated to
  this change.
- golangci-lint is not installed locally; not run.
- Frontend source is unchanged; it was rebuilt only for the embed build.
- No live image request against the Codex upstream before deploy.
- CLIProxyAPI: `TestRegressionIssue5910_UsageStatsCacheWriteTokensInResponses`
  and `TestRegressionIssue6505_DevinClaudeStreamingNoFullInputEstimate` fail
  on the base commit as well as with the fix; not caused by it.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.22.3`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.22.4-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`.
